ACTION: Read `~/.claude/skills/subagent-driven-development/references/fix-loop.md`. The skill requires this before every fix round. It decides who fixes (resumed implementer or fresh agent) and how the re-review runs.

ACTION: Dispatch one fix subagent, resumed or fresh as fix-loop.md says, on model `haiku`. The edit is mechanical and the finding names the exact file and line. The prompt will carry finding F1 verbatim and ask for a change of `--dry_run` to `--dry-run` at `docs/sync.md:12`, a commit, and a report. It will tell the agent to touch no other file.

ACTION: Run `scripts/review-package` on `specs/plans/14-buoy-sync.md` with the fix commit range, so the re-review gets a diff file.

ACTION: Dispatch the scoped re-review from `re-review-prompt.md` on model `sonnet` (the review floor). The prompt will name the diff-file path and F1, and ask for an ADDRESSED or NOT ADDRESSED verdict plus any new Critical or Important issue. It will not tell the reviewer what to ignore.

ACTION: If the re-review is clean, append `Task 3: complete (commits <base7>..<head7>, review clean)` to `.sdd/14-buoy-sync/progress.md`, mark the todo done, and dispatch Task 4.

Message to partner:

Task 3 review found one Important issue: `docs/sync.md:12` writes `--dry_run`, but the flag is `--dry-run`. I am dispatching a fix and then a scoped re-review.
